other_failure_modes.name: Data-dependent feature engineering mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: Feature engineering logic conditionally creates new features based on the minimum value of the current data split rather than the training set. If a feature's minimum value is > 0 in the train split but <= 0 in the validation or test split, the column will not be created, leading to shape mismatches and crashing models.

other_failure_modes.name: Constant feature creation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes scalar values (the number of unique categories for a column in the training set) and assigns them directly to the dataframe for all rows, creating features with zero variance that waste memory and compute.

summary: The agent builds a diverse ensemble of LightGBM and XGBoost models but evaluates them on a single train/validation split and aggregates them using a naive unweighted average. Furthermore, the feature engineering implementation contains critical flaws: it creates useless zero-variance constant features and conditionally creates log-transformed features based on the local split's minimum value, creating a high risk of shape mismatches between train and test sets.
